narrative.overview:
A calm, light-only Romanian study workspace based on the approved statistics page: pale sage canvas, white primary surfaces, deep green ink and Figtree. Compact titles, moderate spacing and restrained 4–6px framing keep the next study task near the top.

Educational prose, figures, tables, captions and explanations remain complete and open. Shared --ui-* tokens define the interface; legacy chapter accents remain where they convey meaning. Personal notebooks keep their continuous cream paper and handwritten chapter title without changing the shared site navigation.
keyCharacteristics: Pale sage canvas, white surfaces and deep-green primary actions from shared --ui-* tokens.
Compact Figtree page titles, readable prose near 70ch and 12–14px supporting labels.
One main framed surface with restrained 24–30px radii; inner content uses headings and fine separators.
Detached responsive header, visible desktop contents/map and accessible drawer behavior.
Continuous cream notebook paper with Caveat only for the written chapter title; shared personal-note materials remain intact.

rules.name: The Compact Type Rule
rules.body: Use Figtree for headings, educational prose, navigation and controls. Page titles normally use 28–46px at weight 600; lesson titles use 27–38px. Fraunces is legacy metadata, not the current homepage direction. Caveat belongs only to the written notebook chapter title.

rules.name: The Single Reading Surface Rule
rules.body: Use one white primary surface with a 4–6px sage frame, 24–30px outer radii and 20–30px interior spacing. Prefer headings, whitespace and fine separators within it. Keep educational matter open; reserve subtle shadows for the detached header and functional overlays.

rules.name: The Notebook Boundary Rule
rules.body: The personal notebook material remains scoped to notite.html. The library uses compact rows with a cover thumbnail and note state on the shared sage canvas. A chapter opens one continuous #fffef9 cream sheet with 32px desktop and 12px phone margins. Contents are a disclosure above the sheet, closed on entry on every viewport. Caveat 600 titles sit inside the paper; Figtree note text uses 16px/32px ruled leading. Every authored main section remains present and editable, including empty sections. One toolbar sticks below the shared header and follows the focused section without moving the caret. Only the active section shows save state and count; global offline/storage failures stay visible. Preserve note bookmarks, local paper depth and print behavior.

rules.name: The Note Materials Rule
rules.body: The lesson panel and notebook keep the shared editor, sanitization and owner-scoped storage. Preserve compact accessible text-color, highlighter, image and sticky controls. Highlighter mode persists for subsequent selections until cleared. Sticky colors use four accessible swatches and a palette that closes after insertion. Images preserve proportions, captions and saved placement, use a 44px resize target, and have no drag handle or movement menu; swiping scrolls the page. Sticky notes retain 44px drag/color/removal controls and semantic left/right/block placement, never absolute coordinates. Keyboard movement and transfers preserve the source until the target accepts it. Narrow panels/phones display blocks while retaining desktop alignment in storage. UI controls never enter serialized content.

rules.name: The Shared Header Rule
rules.body: Use the detached white header with centered Lecții/Testare navigation. Keep it sticky on lessons, quizzes and notebooks. Narrow pages use two compact rows; retain the approved statistics exception. Shared anchor/tool offsets are 88px desktop and 116px on phones. Desktop contents and quiz maps start visible with existing hide preferences; the accessible drawer applies at 1024px and below.

rules.name: The Study Priority Rule
rules.body: Homepage retains its familiar introductory message with the working image/quiz preview to the right, stacking below on tablet and phone. Continue and the compact chapter catalog follow. Testare retains its introductory message and a right-hand progress/recent-activity panel linking to statistics, without duplicate historical score columns. Quizzes retain ten questions per range, visible checked-answer feedback and explanations; common instructions/legend are compact help. Statistics keeps Rezumat/Greșeli/Istoric, immutable initial scores and separate correction results. Account forms are inline on cont.html and dialogs elsewhere; failure/retry messages and export after persistence failure stay directly visible.

dos: Do preserve Romanian diacritics, all authored explanations, figures, captions, section IDs and semantic table relationships.
Do use shared --ui-* tokens for interface surfaces and preserve authored chapter/feedback colors where meaningful.
Do keep prose near 70ch where the layout permits and let figures and tables use the wider content area.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, 44px frequent touch targets, search, reduced motion and usable 320px layouts.
Do distinguish published availability, current traversal progress, immutable initial accuracy and later correction results.
Do preserve authentication, owner-scoped notes/progress, existing public routes and offline behavior; deployment remains a separate action.
donts: Don’t reintroduce the legacy blue interface palette, oversized editorial heroes or new body fonts.
Don’t repeat decorative cards inside a reading surface, add ornamental gradients or animate reading/writing content.
Don’t collapse educational matter or remove existing desktop contents/map access to reduce visual density.
Don’t use color alone for quiz correctness, selected controls or navigation state.
Don’t hide actionable storage/sync errors inside secondary options or imply that local-only data is cloud-backed.
Don’t change existing notebook materials, editor behavior, scoring contracts or data ownership through visual documentation.
